items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Gus, Victor Spencer and I got together a bunch of guys, about eight or nine pieces, and started a band of our own.

ctx.x: I said the Black Eagle. I meant the Banner Band. I'm sorry. I threw you off there. But you knew what I was talking about.
Yeah, that's the band that had a very fine trumpet player named Victor Spencer.
Bunk was in there for a while, too.
